title: Chronic Bronchitis, Chronic Fatigue, Candida, Cystitis, Anemia
excerpt: It has been a slow process, but my health has returned and I am convinced the Hippocrates program is the best way to regain and maintain health.
content:
It has been a slow process, but my health has returned and I am convinced the Hippocrates program is the best way to regain and maintain health. l am back to work full-time and most of my illnesses have disappeared. The rest are under control. I feel like a human being again. I really believe our bodies need the chance to repair them- selves through nutrition and exercise. Your program has done more for me than anything else l have done in my ten- year search for health.

I love watching my sprouts grow and my green drinks. Thank you so much for everything you are doing. I wish you all the best of luck.
